title: FY2027 DPWH NEP to HGAB 3rd Reading mapping detail; Butuan first

sources.nep: 2027.json and Official NEP source records from stage_trace_2027.json

method.matching: Visible HGAB allocations; Official NEP source records augment the independently validated local Transparency snapshot. One-to-one occurrences; abbreviations and maintenance PAP prefixes normalized. Uncorroborated OCR/native-row-ambiguity titles can only support potential matches. Global candidate search checks PAP, direction and chainage compatibility. 83% fuzzy candidates remain provisional; amount alone never identifies a project.
method.extraction: Visible native text cropped to PDF CropBox; visual row grouping, full wrapped descriptions, printed hierarchy leaf allocations; no title/amount deduplication or inferred amounts
method.limits: Provisional automated links. No manual certification of additions/removals. Engineering-office allocation labels are not legislative district assignments.

pdfCrossCheck.note: A district summary cross-check; the document edition is not established.
